message.content: {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Description: \"We used the Infinium HumanHT-12 platform to profile gene expression\"; Technology: Array assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Dataset uses human expression microarray platform (Illumina HumanHT-12) profiling RNA from human samples."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/Description: \"high-grade soft tissue sarcomas\"; Experimental Factors: SARCOMA SUBTYPE; Samples: primary untreated high-grade soft tissue sarcomas.","justification":"The study concerns soft tissue sarcomas, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description and samples list refer to soft tissue sarcomas and sarcoma cell lines; Organism part: Not found; no brain/CNS tissue indicated.","justification":"Samples are tumor (soft tissue) and cell lines, with no evidence of brain or other CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples list includes 13 representative sarcoma cell lines (e.g., HT1080, MLS1765, MLS402, SW872, FU-DDLS-1, etc.).","justification":"Dataset includes patient-derived/established tumor cell lines (in vitro models), which meets the exclusion criterion for non-clinical in vitro models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: Not found; Experimental Factors: SARCOMA SUBTYPE, TUMOR CELL LINE, AGE YRS, SEX; no case vs control grouping described.","justification":"No evidence of a case/control study design (comparisons are by sarcoma subtype/cell line rather than disease vs healthy control)." },"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title/Description: soft tissue sarcomas; Organism part: Not found; samples are non-CNS soft tissue tumors and cell lines.","justification":"Tissues sampled are non-CNS (soft tissue sarcomas), which are not regions affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Description: Infinium HumanHT-12 platform for gene expression.","justification":"The technology is microarray-based expression profiling (compatible); no RNA-seq or proteomics reported."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset is human microarray expression profiling, it does not pertain to ALS-FTD, does not involve CNS tissue, includes in vitro tumor cell lines, and lacks a case/control design. These factors violate multiple inclusion/exclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Description: 'we used ... microarray analysis.'","justification":"The experiment used microarray-based transcription profiling on human samples (RNA assays), so it meets the human microarray expression profiling requirement."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/Description: study of Hereditary Motor and Sensory Neuropathies (HMSN1A, HMSN-LOM) and CCFDN syndrome; genes PMP22, NDRG1, CTDP1 are mentioned. No mention of ALS or FTD.","justification":"The dataset investigates inherited peripheral demyelinating neuropathies (HMSN, CCFDN), not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/Description: 'Transcription profiling of human Schwann cells ...'; Samples: human Schwann cell lines.","justification":"Samples are human Schwann cells (peripheral nervous system glia), not brain or CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'we analyzed human Schwann cell lines from three normal subjects, one HMSN-LOM patient, two HMSN-1A patients and two CCFDN patients' and Experimental design: cell lines and technical/biological replicates.","justification":"Data derive from patient-derived and control Schwann cell lines (in vitro), which are non-clinical cell-line models and thus excluded by criterion 4."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description/Design: includes neuropathy patient-derived cell lines and healthy subject-derived cell lines (three healthy subjects and multiple patient samples); comparisons made between neuropathy samples and controls/reference pool.","justification":"The study compares diseased (patient) cell lines to healthy controls (although via a common reference), consistent with a case/control comparison."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples are Schwann cells (PNS); no CNS brain regions are sampled.","justification":"ALS-FTD affects CNS regions (motor neurons, frontal/temporal cortex); Schwann cells are peripheral and not among CNS regions significantly affected by ALS-FTD."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; description explicitly states microarray analysis.","justification":"The technology used is microarray expression profiling (compatible), not RNA-seq or proteomics."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset uses human microarray profiling, it studies peripheral demyelinating neuropathies using patient-derived Schwann cell lines (PNS, in vitro), not ALS-FTD or human CNS tissue. It therefore fails inclusion criteria 2 and 3 and meets exclusion criterion 4 (in vitro cell lines)."}, "q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Dataset uses microarray transcription profiling on human samples (array-based RNA assay)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Sample metadata: Disease: cancer; Description: dataset profiles a broad range of normal tissues and cell lines; no mention of Lewy body disease, Parkinson's disease, or DLB.","justification":"No indication the study targets Lewy body diseases (LBD); disease annotations show cancer or normal tissues rather than LBD.}"},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Sample metadata: Organism part: caudate nucleus; Organism: Homo sapiens; Developmental stage: adult.","justification":"At least one human CNS sample (caudate nucleus) is included in the dataset.}"},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Additional attributes list CellLine: Daudi and CellType/hepatocyte; Description lists profiling of cell lines and tissues.","justification":"Dataset contains in vitro cell lines (e.g., Daudi, hepatocyte cell preparations), indicating inclusion of non-clinical cell line samples.}"},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs include disease_state_design and organism_part_comparison_design, but sample annotations show cancer/normal and cell lines; no LBD cases or matched control group described; sample count listed as 1.","justification":"There is no clear case/control design comparing LBD cases to controls; disease_state appears to reflect cancer/normal or diverse conditions rather than an LBD case/control study.}"},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: caudate nucleus (CNS) is present, but additional attributes list non-CNS cell types (hepatocyte) and cell lines (Daudi); disease annotations include cancer.","justification":"While the caudate nucleus (a striatal region) is relevant to LBD, the dataset also contains non-CNS tissues and cell lines not relevant to LBD neurodegeneration. Overall the study is a broad tissue/cell-line compendium rather than focused on LBD-affected brain regions.}"},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial: Not found in sample annotations; no mention of familial LBD in description.","justification":"No evidence that cases are familial LBD; familial status not reported.}"},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The study uses microarray technology (compatible). No RNA-seq or proteomics-only modalities reported.}"},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude. Although this is a human microarray dataset and includes at least one relevant CNS region (caudate nucleus), it is not about Lewy body diseases, lacks an LBD case/control design, and contains non-clinical cell lines and cancer samples. These factors fail multiple inclusion/exclusion criteria (not LBD-focused, contains in vitro cell lines, no LBD case/control), so it should not be included."},"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens; Sample count: 41.","justification":"Human samples profiled by microarray (array-based transcription profiling of human RNA)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title: Gene expression profiles in motor cortex of Control and Sporadic Amyotrphic Lateral Sclerosis patients; Disease (sample metadata): normal, Sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.","justification":"The study is of sporadic ALS, not Lewy body diseases (LBD)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: v4 cortex; Title indicates motor cortex samples.","justification":"Samples are from human brain (motor cortex), a CNS tissue. (Post-mortem cortical tissue implied by clinical/PMI factors.)"},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type/line: Not found; Experimental material: organ/tissue (motor cortex) from human donors.","justification":"Samples are post-mortem human brain tissue, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: case control design, clinical history design; Experimental Factors include disease: normal, Sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.","justification":"The study explicitly uses a case–control design comparing ALS cases and controls."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: v4 cortex / motor cortex.","justification":"Motor cortex is primarily implicated in ALS; it is not a primary or commonly targeted region in Lewy body diseases (which mainly affect substantia nigra, limbic structures and association cortices). Therefore the sampled region is not clearly relevant to LBD neuropathology."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Disease listed as Sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis; Clinical/familial metadata include familial anamnesis but disease classification is sporadic.","justification":"Cases are described as sporadic ALS rather than familial LBD; familial anamnesis entries do not indicate familial LBD-only cases."},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The assay technology is microarray, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although this is a human microarray case–control study using CNS tissue, the disease is sporadic ALS (not LBD) and samples are from motor cortex, a region relevant to ALS but not to Lewy body disease neuropathology. Thus it fails the disease and brain-region inclusion criteria."},"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Assay count: 32","justification":"The study uses array-based transcription profiling (microarray) on human-derived samples (RNA assay), matching the microarray expression profiling requirement."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description and Experimental Factors list Disease: parkinson's disease, normal; Title: Rotenone susceptibility phenotype ... model of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease","justification":"The dataset studies Parkinson's disease (idiopathic PD), which falls under Lewy body diseases (LBD)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: Cell type: olfactory neurosphere-derived cell; Organism part: Not found; Description: cells derived from the olfactory epithelium of idiopathic PD patients","justification":"Samples are patient-derived olfactory neurosphere (hONS) cells from the olfactory epithelium, not human brain/CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title: ... patient cells as a model of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease; Description: cells derived from the olfactory epithelium ... PD-hONS cells; Samples list cell type: olfactory neurosphere-derived cell; Experimental Designs include compound treatment design","justification":"The study uses patient-derived in vitro cellular models (hONS cells) and tests compound treatments (rotenone), i.e., an in vitro disease model, which meets the exclusion criterion."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: case control design, compound treatment design; Experimental Factors: disease (parkinson's disease, normal); Sample count: 32","justification":"The design includes case (PD) and control (normal) groups, indicating a case/control study component."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: Not found; Samples are olfactory neurosphere-derived cells (from olfactory epithelium) rather than sampled brain regions","justification":"No brain regions are sampled; the dataset uses peripheral olfactory-derived cells, so the question of irrelevant brain regions is not applicable."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial: Not found; Title/Description: idiopathic Parkinson’s disease","justification":"The study concerns idiopathic (sporadic) Parkinson's disease; no indication it is limited to familial LBD cases."},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay","justification":"The assay is array-based (microarray) and RNA profiling, which is compatible with the required technology."},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset is human, microarray-based, case/control and targets Parkinson's disease (an LBD), it uses patient-derived olfactory neurosphere-derived in vitro cell models rather than human CNS/brain tissue. This violates exclusion criterion 4 (patient-derived in vitro models) and the requirement for CNS tissue, so it should be excluded."},"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}
